NOTE: THIS IS A REQUEST, NOT A DECISION. Unsigned; decision is not ADMIT and provenance names no principal. The identity string is not the boundary: it selects which public key in allowed_signers must have signed. The boundary is possession of the private key, held off-host and never present on the research host, together with protection of allowed_signers. Only the admission authority may author and sign.
